title: MCP document server + filesystem pin + recovery
acceptance_criterion: Tools work through the protocol and a repeated action does not duplicate the mock effect
stdout:
Phase 2 shipped. Custom document MCP server over stdio (protocol revision 2026-07-28 pinned in
the initialize handshake) exposing search_docs and read_document. Pinned filesystem MCP server
scoped to fixtures/docs/ only, with a scope_guard that refuses paths outside that root.
Duplicate-delivery / recovery behaviour is enforced by the idempotent ledger (dedupe on
action_key).

Follow-up (tracked, from the /dev-kit:security pass on PR #8): the single_agent / planner_executor
TOOL branches are currently tool-less; only the fixed graph wires the MCP tools end to end.
evidence: src/agentops_workbench/mcp/mcp_servers/document/server.py — stdio JSON-RPC; initialize / tools/list / tools/call; search_docs + read_document
src/agentops_workbench/mcp/mcp_servers/filesystem/scope_guard.py — path scope enforcement for the pinned @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem
tests/mcp/test_document_server.py = 22 tests, all pass (includes protocol handshake + unknown-tool -32601 + out-of-scope path rejection)
mock ticket ledger idempotency is covered by tests/test_api_runs.py + tests/worker/test_runner.py
